segments.title: Which planet's DAY is longer than its YEAR?
segments.say: Which planet has a day that's longer than its year? Mars, Venus, or Jupiter? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: It's Venus!
segments.say: It's Venus! One spin takes two hundred and forty three Earth days.

segments.title: But its year is shorter
segments.sub: One trip around the Sun: **225 days**
segments.say: But one trip around the Sun takes only two hundred and twenty five.

segments.title: It even spins BACKWARDS
segments.say: And it spins backwards, the opposite way to most planets.

segments.title: Hot enough to melt lead
segments.say: Oh, and its days are hot enough to melt lead.

segments.sub: Venus, Mars or Jupiter: what was your guess?
segments.say: Did you guess Venus? Comment below.
